mentions.h: NOVEMBER 22ND 1980 - WIMBLEDON - BELGRAVE OPEN 7 / THE BERMAN CUP

mentions.note: 44th National 10 miles; 7th Hornchurch 10 km; 4th Metropolitan 20 km; 9th Southern Area 20 miles; 2nd Belgrave and Middlesex championships; 5th Traders 7 miles; 2nd Police Championships Barking to Southend; 9th Mercury 20 miles; 2nd Southern Track 10 km; absent from National 35 km; won Gloucester 7 miles; 5th National 50 km; 6th Southern 20 km; won G.L.C. 3 km; 7th London Postal Region 10 km

Belgrave 10: 95 minutes two years ago, 75 mins this year; disqualified Chippenham to Calne; 1st Belgrave and Surrey County 3 Kms 12.59; Woodford 1 Hr 12.605 km; 3rd Bexley 10KMS 46.18; 4th Belgrave Open 7 mile; 2nd Gosport 10 Kms; 3rd City of London 10 kms 46.10; 6th Met.Police Open; 3rd Belgrave 10M Champs; injured for Luton; missed National 10 Mile with ankle injury and picket duty in the Midlands

photos.c: Derek Crookes receives the South London News Group Award from Mick Ledbury which was presented to Belgrave's walkers for'Outstanding Sports Achievements' earlier in the year. Also L. to R. are; Paul Blagg, Stephan Marshall,Paul Warburton, Carl Lawton, Ron Day, John Newnham, John Hall.
